<!-- pr-reviewer: e240dad1dcc82bde626504941f5f7168275622fe -->
Needs changes before merge.

The example meets the catalog layout. Its script reproduces the NC program. The app tests pin the lead moves and tab lifts.

Results ran locally on head `e240dad1dcc82bde626504941f5f7168275622fe` with upstream main `5fdbed9bd8e7a8bb28e6f162a02ab423842b77e8`. The trial merge needed no changes.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. The `example_catalog` suite passed all 3 tests.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: PASS for both cases.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- Heavy lanes: the plan reaches no heavy lane.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: FAIL. One test failed. The screenshot renderer stayed ignored.
- The same suite passed with the new case temporarily removed: 1 passed, 1 ignored. This confirms that the new case causes the failure.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changed. The extra kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Requested before merge:

1. `examples/catalog/2d/contour-tabs/contour-tabs.camproj:2047`: Make the linked model path work when the UI opens the project from another directory. The stored path is `model/contour-tabs.obj`. The UI reads it from the process directory. Thus, `catalog_cases_open_and_frame_cleanly` fails at `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs:119`. The app catalog tests do not check this UI path. Make the committed project and the rebuilt project open cleanly. Keep the catalog test enabled.

Failure text:

```text
contour-tabs.camproj failed to open: contour-tabs kept as it is: its linked file model/contour-tabs.obj cannot be read (No such file or directory (os error 2))
test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed; 1 ignored
```

Safety checks and mutations:

- I read all 104 lines of the new NC program. No existing golden moved. The cut levels are Z4, Z2 and Z0. There are six lead-in arcs and four tab lifts at Z0.
- I checked every motion line. No motion goes below Z0. All XY rapid moves stay above the stock. The largest arc radius mismatch is 0.000473 mm.
- The project mesh is closed and consistently oriented. Its volume is 25,800 cubic millimetres.
- Mutation 1: remove the case folder. The pinning test fails because the NC file is missing. Restore the case: GREEN.
- Mutation 2: replace the Z4 `G03` lead-in with `G01`. The pinning test fails at the lead-in count. Restore the NC file: GREEN.
- After both restorations, all 3 app catalog tests pass. The worktree has no tracked changes.

The PR changes no UI source. Before/after UI screenshots do not apply. No machine run or control simulation ran.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The contour-tabs project now opens without a linked model file. The build script removes the link before it saves the embedded mesh.

- Committed project pin: `every_catalog_case_opens_regenerates_verifies_and_posts_byte_for_byte` checks the embedded mesh and the absent link.
- Rebuilt project pin: `every_catalog_case_rebuilds_from_camscript` loads the rebuilt project outside the script directory and checks the same conditions.
- Each pin failed when its fix was reverted. Each pin passed after restoration.
- The enabled UI test `catalog_cases_open_and_frame_cleanly` passed from `crates/ui`. The screenshot renderer stayed ignored.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed on the new head. All three app catalog tests passed.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check` passed for both cases.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

New head: `bbe22423c6143d17c205de4f3a99259a7450975d`.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: bbe22423c6143d17c205de4f3a99259a7450975d -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier finding is resolved. The committed project embeds the mesh without a source link. The build script removes the link before saving. Both projects load outside the script directory. The enabled UI catalog test passes.

Results ran locally after a clean trial merge with upstream main `0510ff382`. No GitHub runner ran.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. All 3 tests in `example_catalog` pass.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: PASS for `2d/contour-tabs` and `2d/first-part`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.

Extra suites run:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: PASS. One test passes. The screenshot renderer remains ignored.
- A search for catalog readers found `example_catalog` and `catalog_render`. Both suites ran.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changes. The extra kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Safety checks and mutations:

- I read all 104 lines of the new NC program. No existing golden changes. The cut levels are Z4, Z2 and Z0. Six lead-in arcs and four tab lifts match the case description.
- No motion block goes below Z0. Each XY rapid move stays above the stock. The largest arc radius mismatch is 0.000473 mm.
- The mesh has 16 vertices and 28 triangles. It is closed and consistently oriented. Its volume is 25,800 cubic millimetres. The embedded facets match the OBJ.
- Remove the case folder: RED at the missing NC assertion. Restore it: GREEN.
- Replace the Z4 lead-in `G03` with `G01`: RED at the lead-in count. Restore it: GREEN.
- Restore the old source link in the committed project: RED at the absent-link assertion.
- Remove `set_model_link` from the build script: RED at the rebuilt project's absent-link assertion.
- After all restorations, all 3 app catalog tests pass. No tracked changes remain in the review worktree.

Requested before merge: none.

The PR changes no UI source. Before/after UI screenshots do not apply. No machine run or control simulation ran.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
